title: The Homecoming of the water tower
author: Tamsin Sterling
blurb: Odile Thornbury, a debate champion who can't win the argument at home, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. Then the teacher pairs nemesis with nemesis for a semester-long project — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does before graduation.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
